slides.title: Logging them into AI *isn't enough*
slides.body: They stop after a week. They don't know what it can do.

slides.title: Not how. *What it can do.*
slides.body: Anything on a screen, an agent can probably handle.

slides.title: Build it. Teach it. *Hand them a chat.*
slides.body: Then duplicate it for the next client in the niche.
